title.rendered: Notice to Graduands: 5th Session of the 18th Congregation Ceremony

content.rendered:
It is announced for the information of 2026 Graduands in the School of Graduate Studies of the University of Professional Studies, Accra, and the general public that the 5th Session of the 18th Congregation Ceremony of the University will be held as follows:

Date: Tuesday, 1st December, 2026
Time: 10.00 a.m.
Venue: Kofi Ohene-Konadu Auditorium (KOKA)

Registration for the Congregation:

Ph.D and one-year MA and MSc students who have successfully completed their programmes of study in October/November 2026 at the School of Graduate Studies and wish to be presented at this ceremony are requested to follow the registration procedure outlined below, starting from Monday, 23rd November, 2026.

A non-refundable fee of GH¢600.00 should be paid at any branch of Access Bank Ltd, and the payment disbursed on the UFIS student payment portal as a graduation fee.

Graduands should log in to their USIS student portal and click the “Register for Graduation” tab to register for the graduation ceremony.

The registration deadline is Monday, 30th November, 2026. No late registration will be entertained.

List of Graduands: The list of graduands is available on the University’s website via Graduation List 2026.

Collection and Return of the Academic Gown:

Use your proof of registration and the UFIS disbursement printout to collect your gown and souvenirs from the Ground Floor of the Yaw Adutwum Building starting from Tuesday, 24th November, 2026.

The deadline for the gown collection is Monday, 30th November, 2026 at 5.00 pm.

Graduands are requested to return their academic gowns by 5:00 p.m. on Thursday, 3rd December, 2026. Failure to do so will incur a penalty of GH¢50.00 per day.

Attire:

Those to be presented are expected to be seated in the Auditorium by 9:00 am, wearing the appropriate academic gown over a suit or jacket, with a UPSA necktie or scarf for ladies.

title.rendered: No Fees Stress Biodata Upload to the Student Loan Trust Fund (SLTF) Portal by 2026/2027 Academic Year First-Year Students

content.rendered:
All undergraduate (Level 100) and diploma (Year One) registered fresh students are required to complete the Google Form below to facilitate the upload of their biodata to the SLTF portal.

Form Link: https://forms.gle/oNiQZ8CQferBLoMm6

Students are required to provide their Ghana Card details and other relevant personal information.

Please ensure that all information provided is accurate and carefully verified before submission.

Students who do not have Ghana Cards are required to obtain one before completing the form, as the Ghana Card number is a mandatory requirement.

All students are required to complete the form by Thursday, 26th November, 2026, to ensure timely upload and processing of their information.

All first-year students are to take note and act accordingly.

Signed

Anthony Afeadie

Director of Academic Affairs

title.rendered: Hostel room reservation for continuing students (level 200- 400 students) | Second Semester – 2025/26

content.rendered:
SECOND SEMESTER OF THE 2025/2026 ACADEMIC YEAR FOR CONTINUING STUDENTS (LEVEL 200- 400 STUDENTS)

 

Notice is hereby given that all continuing students (levels 200 – 400) interested in residing at the University’s Hostels for the 2nd semester of the 2025/2026 academic are to take note of the following:

 

  1. A new application process will be used for the booking hence kindly read the Application process below thoroughly.
  2. Booking and payment for the Hostels are for a Semester Stay.
  3. Payment confirms booking for allocation of bed when instructed to do so from the deputy directors office.
  4. Students interested in the University’s Hostel Accommodation will have to apply at Deputy Director’s office in Hostel A from Monday 8th December to Friday 12th December, 2025, 9am to 3pm each day.
  5. Payment deadline for all continuing students is Wednesday 31st December, 2025.
  6. Check-in details for level 200 300 and 400 students:
  • Registration at the Hostels will commence on Friday, 27th February, 2026 from 10am.
  • Deadline for registration at the Hostels is Sunday, 1st March, 2026 after which all beds not registered for will be allocated to other students in need of accommodation.

 

N/B: PLEASE DO NOT APPLY FOR HOSTEL ACCOMMODATION IF YOU ARE NOT INTERESTED IN RESIDING AT THE HOSTELS. When you apply you will be required to pay if considered for allocation.

 

  1. HOSTEL APPLICATION PROCESS

 

  • APPLICATION PROCESS

 

a) Apply for the hostel at the Deputy Director’s office in Hostel A.

b) You will be required to complete an application form with the following information:

  • Your Name and Student ID
  • Contact
  • Preferred Hostel
  • Preferred room category whether 4 in room or 2 in room.

 

N/B: AN APPLICATION FOR HOSTEL DOES NOT MEAN AN AUTOMATIC BED ALLOCATION.

 

1.3 ALLOCATION CONFIRMATION

  1. Payment confirms booking for allocation of bed.
  2. Any student who does not pay the required hostel fees within the deadline will not get bed allocation.

 

  1. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

  1. Read the Rules and Regulations governing the Hostels on the University’s website (www.upsa.edu.gh) before applying.
  2. Hostel fee payment procedure is the same as academic facility user fee payment (you pay into the University Access Bank account, the money will be transferred into your UFIS wallet, then you disburse according to other Hostel fee items on the portal).

title.rendered: Reactivation of UPSA Student Fee Payment Platform (UFIS)

content.rendered:
NOTICE

REACTIVATION OF UPSA STUDENT FEE PAYMENT PLATFORM-UFIS

This is to inform all students of the University that the student fee payment platform, also known as UFIS, has been reactivated after being temporarily unavailable due to a technical issue.

Students can now easily pay and disburse their fees and other charges for resit, late registration, English language, attestation, letter of introduction and transcript services etc.

We are grateful to all students for their patience and understanding during the downtime of UFIS.

Thank you.

SIGNED
Anthony Afeadie
Director of Academic Affairs
